**Sweet Tato Stew** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Tato stew, sweetened with sugar and added mutfruits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Mutfruit (2) Sugar (1) Tato (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Sweet Tato Stew | | Sweet Tato Stew (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station after having learned the recipe.
- Can be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is set to run in "Proletariat" mode.
- May be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.

Due to missing the keyword "TypeFoodHealing", this food is not buffed or affected by the Carnivore and Herbivore mutations, the Strange In Numbers perk and Magazines.
